contracts.instruction: Return every requested field using exactly its specified column alias. Preserve complete case-sensitive repository-relative paths and symbol IDs; do not substitute display names. Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. After executing SQL, describe the returned rows and query assumptions. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. 19.guidance: List each pair once, with the lexicographically smaller package in package_a.

20.guidance: Return the package-directory area and file count. Order by files descending, then area ascending.

21.guidance: Return both the test file path and its distinct target count. Break ties by test_file_id ascending.
